verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is an international law firm selling legal advisory services, so reading its source under an open license is a category error for this kind of product. The few client tools it offers (e.g. the SCC and Term Sheet generators) run on third-party Contract Express, and nothing in the evidence suggests the firm ships or publishes source code of its own.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
